dogecoin.text: Large investors are selling their Dogecoin holdings to invest in ETFSwap, a blockchain platform for decentralized ETF trading that is expected to undergo a beta launch after passing a KYC audit.
Grayscale has filed with the SEC to create a Dogecoin Trust, potentially converting it into an ETF, joining others in the pursuit of offering Dogecoin investment products.

The US Securities and Exchange Commission has clarified that proof-of-work mining activities on decentralized networks such as Bitcoin, Litecoin, and Dogecoin are not considered securities transactions, provided they meet specific criteria.
